description: Typed provider registry (sys_device_router-style wire header [0x0D][dir u8][id u8][op u16][args], where op = 0x0D00 | n or driver own op 0xFFxx).

commands.label: Create a provider
commands.description: Creates a typed provider under `id` from a self-registered driver type.

fields.label: Config
fields.description: Driver type's packed create configuration struct

commands.label: Remove a provider
commands.description: Removes a provider (not the board's own): its port out of the data matrix first, then its driver, after the call into it in flight.

commands.label: List providers
commands.description: Called with id = 0xFF (SYS_DATA_PROVIDER_ID_NONE); returns every registered provider.

returns.label: Number of providers
returns.description: Followed by sys_data_provider_entry_t rows (3 B each: provider u8, type u8, state u8).

commands.label: Provider info
commands.description: Returns type (u8) and state (u8) as sys_data_provider_info_t (2 B).

commands.label: Supported ops
commands.description: Returns [op u16][sides u8] rows (bit 0 = read, bit 1 = write) for registry ops and the driver's own ops.
